title: Whole Quatrefoil and Four Petal Tracery
description: One newly authored complete unglazed circular architectural tracery insert. One shared-vertex thick stone-look shell joins a broad stepped outer annular frame, a continuous central four-lobed curved aperture border and four narrow diagonal connectors, leaving four real broad curved petal apertures around the central opening. All five openings pass through the finite depth; front and back outer lips project beyond the integral tracery faces. Three opaque PBR surface regions belong to one continuous mesh, not flat hole decals, floating strips or a wheel with a central axle. No host wall, glass, masonry seams or support stand is included. Entire geometry newly drawn, not an old rectangular crossbar window rounded or handwheel relabelled. Metre Z-up and full horizontal-envelope-centred minimum-Z origin. One static wall-insert prop, zero scenes; architectural game-art only, no actual building installation, structural load, glazing specification, historical authenticity or safety. No motion, animation, interaction or functional wheel.
